policy.acceptance: Zero Critical and zero unaccepted High on productionScan. Full-tree Critical/High allowed only if listed here with owner + future expiry.
policy.reviewCadence: Monthly or on advisory for vite / vite-plugin-pwa / react-router

notes: Runtime = packages shipped in the Vite production browser bundle (dependencies).
Dev/build = tooling used at install/build/lint time only (devDependencies); not browser attack surface for end users.
tailwindcss / @tailwindcss/vite are compile-time CSS tooling and live under devDependencies.
Abandoned sheetjs `xlsx` was unused in source and removed (prefer CSV or a maintained spreadsheet lib if export is needed later).
Migrated from react-router-dom@7 to react-router@8.3+ to clear High advisories affecting Framework/RSC paths.
Production SBOM is generated with `npm sbom --omit=dev` (no CycloneDX CLI dependency).

exceptions.cveOrAdvisory: GHSA-fv7c-fp4j-7gwp (@babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs 7.12.0-7.29.0 generates arbitrary code when compiling malicious input). No fixed 7.x release; fixed in Babel 8.x only. Parent: vite-plugin-pwa → workbox-build → @babel/preset-env.
exceptions.exploitability: Dev/build only. Plugin runs during PWA/service-worker generation on developer/CI machines, not in the production browser bundle. Exploit requires feeding attacker-controlled JS through workbox-build's Babel pipeline.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Production SCA gate uses npm audit --omit=dev (must stay clean). Do not process untrusted source through workbox-build. Track workbox / vite-plugin-pwa release that moves to Babel 8, or drop PWA plugin if unused in deploy.
